quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the importance of education and his grandmother's influence
quotes.excerpt: My grandmother, she was the one that taught me the importance of education and the importance of school.
quotes.quote: The person that I would say I admire most would be my grandmother. My grandmother, she passed away three years ago, but she was the one that taught me the importance of education and the importance of school. I carry the things that she taught me with me in life today. It is important to give appreciation to your parents, your grandparents, your ancestors, the people that came before. Always show them respect.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his grandmother's impact on his foundation's mission
quotes.excerpt: I started it basically because of my grandmother. She was a social worker, she was a teacher.

text_blocks.speaker: Unnamed Student
text_blocks.text: I know that your 7uice Foundation focuses on reading and the opportunity for the underserved youth. So how much of that mission do you think comes from your grandmother's dedication to education and the underserved?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: Great question. My 7uice Foundation that you mentioned, I started it basically because of my grandmother. She was a social worker, she was a teacher. She always spent her time donating to the charity and giving back to certain families. I remember going to feed the homeless, always doing my church activities. My grandmother gave me a sense of community. Once I made it to the NBA, I decided to start a foundation dedicated to giving back. It is always paying homage to the inspiration of my grandmother.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his potential career path after basketball
quotes.excerpt: If I had to choose anything, I probably would be a teacher at a university.

text_blocks.speaker: Unnamed Student
text_blocks.text: If you ended your basketball career tomorrow, what seed do you hope you have planted in this world?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: If basketball were to end today, it is tough for me to say, but if I had to choose anything, I probably would be a teacher at a university. I love to teach. I love working with students such as yourself. I work with students at MIT and Harvard back in Boston. I love to teach and build curriculums and just pour into the next generation. You guys are going to be the future.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his grandmother's influence on his academic discipline
quotes.excerpt: She prepared me for life. She prepared me for university.

text_blocks.speaker: Unnamed Student
text_blocks.text: Is there anything that you want to say to your grandmother when you are too shy to say when you are a teenager?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: When I was a teenager, I used to give my grandmother a hard time because she was a teacher and educator. Even in the summertime, she would make me do book reports, mathematics, and physics. I just wanted to play video games and play basketball. When I got to college, I took a class and the assignment was to call the people that helped you get to where you are now. I called my grandmother and thanked her because even though I gave her a hard time when I was a teenager, she prepared me for life. She prepared me for university. A lot of the reason why people give credit to my intelligence is because of my grandmother. She made me do that at an early age.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on balancing professional sports with personal development
quotes.excerpt: You need to prioritize. Some things that may be a hard decision, you might have to sacrifice.

text_blocks.speaker: Unnamed Student
text_blocks.text: How do you balance your daily life, your basketball career, and so many other education activities or charities?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: As you balance your life, you need to prioritize. I wrote down what was most important to me in terms of my education, sports, social life, and sleep. Some things that may be a hard decision, you might have to sacrifice for what is the most important. For me, sports and education were most important. I had to sacrifice a lot of that in my life because sports and education take a lot of time. It is very demanding. You might have to just put focus on more of the priorities and sacrifice some of the things that you want to do in order to be successful.
